confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which swings widely with July school-holiday and dry-season demand in Port Douglas. The FX figure comes from a search summary attributing 0.6955 to the RBA 4pm reading for 15 Oct 2026; OFX's mid-market 0.695572 for the same date is consistent, but I did not open the RBA table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Queensland tourism base, benchmarked mainly against Cairns (nearby, same region) with a resort-town premium on dining and accommodation in peak July season. Drinks are estimated from local beer prices.
